name: Anthropic Claude API web fetch tool
description: Provider-hosted fetch tool that retrieves web pages and PDFs whose URLs already appeared in the conversation.

provenance.notes: Supports version web_fetch_20260318, no additional cost beyond tokens (billing_class included), max_uses with no default limit, allowed/blocked domains, max_content_tokens, URL must already be in context, data exfiltration warning, error codes. side_effect read_only is a project classification (HTTP GET of URLs), with exfiltration risk noted in the research note.
